sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A descendant of the mysterious secret society known as the Assassins uses his newfound knowledge and physical skills to battle the power-hungry Templar Order.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: District 9
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Callous bureaucrat Wikus van de Merwe helps evict a group of aliens from a Johannesburg shanty town, but has to go on the run when he becomes infected after being exposed to their technology.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek Generations
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soren. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Accountant
sky cinema thriller.desc: A mild mannered, socially weird government accountant moonlights as a highly trained, and deadly assassin.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema greats.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
sky cinema greats.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

sky cinema greats.title: Caddyshack
sky cinema greats.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

sky cinema greats.title: Arthur
sky cinema greats.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

sky cinema drama.title: Wish You Were Here
sky cinema drama.desc: When a perfect night with a perfect stranger ends suddenly the next morning, Charlotte searches for answers and meaning in her life. However, she soon uncovers a shocking secret that changes everything she knows about the man who captured her heart.

sky cinema drama.title: Philadelphia
sky cinema drama.desc: Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.

sky cinema drama.title: Jackie
sky cinema drama.desc: The days leading up to the tragedy of President John F. Kennedy's assassination and its immediate aftermath are chronicled as they were experienced by the First Lady, wife of the charismatic president and mother of two small children.

sky cinema drama.title: Hamnet
sky cinema drama.desc: William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece `Hamlet'.
